remarks: Located at the end of a cul-de-sac in the private Eagle Drive Road this North Stamford Contemporary home is ready for you to move in. This very spacious home has a 3 car garage, 5 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, 1st floor home office and plenty of space. This lovely home has an open floor, 2 large wood decks overlooking the wooded and tranquil backyard. The Living Room has large 8 foot windows that allows for a direct view of the rear Deck and yard.
